notes.body: Massachusetts adjusts your premium with your driving record through the SDIP merit-rating system. At-fault accidents and traffic violations add surcharge points (tracked by the Merit Rating Board); a clean record earns an excellent-driver credit.
notes.title: Safe Driver Insurance Plan (SDIP)

notes.body: Massachusetts is a no-fault state. Every policy must include at least $8,000 in PIP, which covers medical expenses and lost wages regardless of who caused the accident.
notes.title: Personal Injury Protection is mandatory

notes.body: MA requires at least $25,000/$50,000 bodily-injury liability, $30,000 property damage, and $8,000 PIP. Financed or leased cars typically need collision and comprehensive too.
notes.title: Minimum coverage

notes.body: Massachusetts insurers may not use credit-based insurance scores, gender, marital status, or homeownership when setting premiums. Age may only be used to give a discount at 65+.
notes.title: What's not used in your rate

sources: 211 CMR 134.00 — Safe Driver Insurance and Merit Rating Plans (mass.gov)
